content.block.contract: data/<id>/horizon/block/<block>.json copying a vanilla template, plus model, blockstate and item files

content.item.contract: data/<id>/horizon/item/<item>.json copying a vanilla template; components patch max_stack_size and rarity

content.lang.contract: assets/<id>/lang/en_us.json and ru_ru.json, copied verbatim into the resource root
content.lang.source: crates/horizon-client/src/mod_content.rs (mod files copied into the resource root)

content.recipe.contract: data/<id>/recipe/<recipe>.json in the vanilla recipe format
content.recipe.source: crates/horizon-client/src/mod_content.rs (data files copied into the resource root)

content.loot_table.contract: data/<id>/loot_table/blocks/<block>.json in the vanilla loot table format
content.loot_table.source: crates/horizon-client/src/mod_content.rs (data files copied into the resource root)

content.block_tag.contract: additions to data/minecraft/tags/block/ (or data/c/tags/), merged in load order like a data pack

content.structure_nbt.contract: data/<id>/structure/<structure>.nbt structure templates; placement needs worldgen data or commands

native.hook_mod.api: native hooks 7 (NATIVE_HOOKS_API) or a pinned horizon_revision
permissions: native code with the player's rights, not sandboxed
native.hook_mod.contract: horizon-mixin.toml plus .rs helpers hooking named game functions (horizon-mixins); built per instance by the launcher
native.hook_mod.note: Horizon builds trusted native .hnmod mods; Studio cannot author them yet (HS-010)
native.hook_mod.note_ru: Horizon собирает доверенные нативные моды .hnmod; Studio пока не умеет их создавать (HS-010)

shader.pack.contract: WGSL sky, material and post stages checked by horizon-shader (new, check, pack)
shader.pack.source: docs/shaders.md; crates/horizon-shader-api (docs/api/stability.md still lists the Shader API as not started)
shader.pack.note: Horizon checks .hshader packs; Studio has no shader authoring yet (HS-013)
shader.pack.note_ru: Horizon проверяет пакеты .hshader; создавать шейдеры в Studio пока нельзя (HS-013)

entity.custom.note: No content-mod registry or verified native hook for custom entities at this revision (master roadmap section 12)
entity.custom.note_ru: На этой ревизии нет ни реестра контентных модов, ни проверенного нативного хука для своих сущностей (раздел 12 мастер-плана)
